create_TGLFNNukaeaTransportModel: create a TGLFNNukaeaTransportModel instance with a specified machine type such as 'multimachine' or 'step'
test_hash_and_eq_same: test that two TGLFNNukaeaTransportModel instances with the same machine produce equal hashes and are equal
build_input_tensor_step: build an input tensor for the TGLFNN-ukaea model using step machine configuration with 15 plasma physics features
build_input_tensor_multimachine: build an input tensor for the TGLFNN-ukaea model using multimachine configuration with 13 plasma physics features
run_call_implementation: run the transport model call_implementation to predict turbulent ion and electron heat fluxes from core profiles
